thread:
maria_cs: Citrine Health requested a short, pre-launch config change for their London demo. They want region routing to UK-LON, an IP allowlist, and a temporary per-key connection increase. Demo window: Wed 10:00-14:00 UTC (3h).

maria_cs: Details from Alex@citrine.health — org_id `org_citrine_84`, api_key_prefix `cit-` (will share full key via secure notes).

maria_cs: Requested changes:
```
- Route traffic to region: europe-lon (preferred), fallback: eu-west-1
- Allowlist CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25, 192.0.2.64/26
- Increase per-API-key concurrent connections: 100 -> 500
- Temporary burst/QPS floor: raise soft QPS from 150 -> 600 for window
- Auto-revoke allowlist + conn increase at 14:00 UTC (end of window)
- Contact: Alex (alex@citrine.health), phone +44 7700 900900
```

ben_ops: thumbs up. Can you confirm exact start time (UTC) and whether they need persistent peering or just edge route? Also need full API key prefix + signed approval doc.

maria_cs: Start 10:00 UTC. They only want a temporary edge route + allowlist for the demo (no long-term peering). Signed approval is inbound, I'll attach to the ticket.

ben_ops: Opening internal ticket now, will tag eng-infra and oncall. Adding auto-revoke at 14:00.

infra-bot: Created ticket CS-8321: "Citrine Health - LON edge allowlist & temporary conn bump" assigned to ben_ops, priority: P2.

ben_ops: @liam_oncall can you validate capacity on the dedicated pool for europe-lon and confirm if we need to fail over to eu-west-1? If europe-lon not available, we should route to eu-west-1 and update customer.

liam_oncall: I checked the dedicated pools — we have headroom for 3h at the requested QPS on the current shard, but the routing change requires an ops rollout (edge rules + NAT updates). I can run the rollout at 09:30 UTC to ensure readiness.

liam_oncall: One ask — please use exact CIDRs only. No /0s. Also recommend we set an internal soft throttle policy at 700 QPS to prevent noisy-key collapse.

ben_ops: Agreed. I'll provision allowlist entries and bump the per-key conn_limit in the config store. Internal change will look like: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood/api/allowlist \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"org_id":"org_citrine_84","cidrs":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.128/25","192.0.2.64/26"],"region":"europe-lon","expires_at":"2026-03-25T14:00:00Z"}'
```

maria_cs: Attached signed approval and full key prefix to CS-8321. Also added a short runbook for the demo owner in the ticket.

sarah_account: FYI — Citrine's renewal is Q3; want to flag that a smooth demo will help the upsell. Please capture any perf anomalies in the ticket.

ben_ops: All set from infra side — allowlist entries scheduled, conn_limit set to 500 for the key prefix, soft throttle 700 QPS active for the window. If europe-lon shows any instability we will flip routing to eu-west-1 and notify Alex.

ben_ops: Will revoke rules and rollback at 14:00 UTC automatically. Manual verification at 14:10 to confirm cleanup.

infra-bot: CS-8321 status -> in-progress (tags: eng-infra, oncall, customer-success).

maria_cs: Thanks team — I'll notify Citrine and confirm demo time to Alex. Will report back any feedback/metrics after the run. :rocket:

liam_oncall: Ping me if latency > 120ms from London region during the demo; I'll promote extra capacity.

ben_ops: Closing note: if we see continuous high QPS beyond the window, we will throttle to protect multi-tenant pools and escalate to account team.

maria_cs: Understood. I'll keep them on a short leash and relay expectations.
